required_findings.criteria: Identifies that fixed text height can clip content at larger font scales and recommends content-driven sizing.
Identifies missing stable item identity as a focus-continuity risk when the lazy list changes.

Identifies that the delete icon's content description repeats the adjacent visible delete text, causing redundant screen-reader output, and recommends exposing one clear accessible label for the action.
Identifies help that is available only through a gesture and requires an equivalent accessible action or control.
Identifies that the custom overlay lacks a modal focus boundary and allows navigation to background content.

forbidden_claims: Claims exact TalkBack speech without device evidence
Claims WCAG or legal compliance from the fixture
Recommends contentDescription on every visible element
